messages:
maya: Heads up: canary promotion for invoices-chart v4.0.0 hit ImagePullBackOff on init sidecar (cert-fetch) in ap-south-1 small pool. deploy-bot blocked further promotions.

deploy-bot: promotion stalled — pod cert-fetch failed to pull image `registry.internal/cert-fetch:2026-03-20` (Unauthorized). Holding promotions.

owen: we rotated the read-only robot key last night, looks like some nodes didn't pick up the new secret. I see `ErrImagePull: unauthorized` on a subset.

diego: curious: v4.0.0 also introduced `global.imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` and bumped `init.sh` retry backoff. if nodes cached old creds it could explain flakiness.

maya: short options: 1) rollback to v3.9.8 (fast, leaves canary stable) 2) patch cluster secrets and retry promote (risk: delays) 3) pin canary namespace to previous chart and mark release pinned so deploy-bot won't auto-promote.

owen: because this touches registry creds, I'd prefer rollback + pin. we can avoid any accidental re-promote while we confirm secrets.

diego: agree. also add an annotation so the automated changelog doesn't mark this as a normal promotion. use `release-management/hold=true` and `release-management/pinned=v3.9.8`.

sre-oncall: I'll sync robot creds and force kubelet secret sync on affected nodes. annotate first so deploy-bot doesn't retry.

maya: commands:```
# prevent auto-promote and pin chart
kubectl annotate namespace invoices-canary release-management/hold=true --overwrite
kubectl annotate namespace invoices-canary release-management/pinned=v3.9.8 --overwrite
# rollback
helm rollback invoices-release 8 --namespace invoices-canary
```

owen: adding a short changelog entry: "Reverted invoices-chart to v3.9.8 due to image-pull auth failures for cert-fetch in v4.0.0; hold applied while robot creds reconcile."

deploy-bot: manual action recorded: rollback requested by @maya for release invoices-release -> target chart v3.9.8. Promotion hold applied.

sre-oncall: creds reconcile started; I'll post node-level status once all pods can pull `registry.internal/cert-fetch:2026-03-20`.

maya: rolling back now. will follow-up with re-promote plan after creds verified and we add an init preflight check in the chart.

deploy-bot: helm rollback successful. release invoices-release -> v3.9.8. Promotion hold remains until annotation removed.

owen: follow-up action: PR to add imagePullSecrets validation to preflight and tighten backoff config. assigning to @diego. ETA 6h.

maya: thanks. leaving hold in place; we'll re-run a small canary once PR merges and creds are confirmed.
